findings.title: The race test's toggler child is stopped only on the success path, with no finally kill and no deadline, so an interrupted test run leaves it running and pinning a core.
findings.evidence: ts/vite.config.test.ts TOGGLER script and the concurrent-renames describe block. Two live orphans found (PPID 1, about 82% CPU, about 47 minutes old) with their /tmp/vite-fs-guard-* trees left behind; the reviewer killed them.
findings.consequence: Runaway processes on shared machines or CI after a timeout or crash.

notes: Rounds 3+4 functional gating review (the guard's security probed separately), dispatched by the Session Manager in its own scratch clone at 91580253.
